name: Aluminum 6061-T6
note: General purpose. Machines fast, anodizes well, the default for fixtures and housings.

name: Aluminum 7075-T6/T651
note: About 1.8× the yield strength of 6061. Used for aerospace brackets and thin-wall parts.

name: Stainless 303
note: Free-machining stainless. Good for fittings; not for welding or saltwater.

name: Stainless 304
note: Common corrosion-resistant grade; work-hardens, so we keep tools sharp and feeds steady.

name: Stainless 316L
note: Low carbon, molybdenum added. Medical and fluid-handling parts; passivated through a partner.

name: Stainless 17-4 PH
note: Precipitation-hardened. Machined in condition A, then aged to H900–H1150 by a partner.

name: Titanium Grade 2
note: Commercially pure. Formable, corrosion resistant, used for medical housings.

name: Titanium Grade 5 (6Al-4V)
note: The workhorse titanium alloy for implants-adjacent instruments and aerospace fittings.

name: Brass C360
note: Free-cutting brass. Ideal for Swiss-turned connectors and valve parts.

name: Tool steel (A2, D2, O1)
note: For wear parts and tooling. Rough machined, heat treated by a partner, then finished by wire EDM or grinding.

name: Inconel 718
note: Heat-resistant superalloy. Slow to cut and quoted accordingly; we tell you early if a feature is costly.

name: Delrin (acetal, POM)
note: Stable, low friction, holds tolerance well for a plastic. Gears, bushings, test fixtures.

name: PEEK
note: High-temperature, chemically resistant plastic. Medical and semiconductor parts; annealed stock only.

name: Ultem (PEI)
note: Amber, flame-retardant, sterilizable. Instrument handles and electrical insulators.
